name: daily-driver
description: Workflow booster: a focus goal band, a ping when long turns finish, a daily work log with /eod, and /handoff to resume tomorrow where you stopped.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Notify after (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: Send a desktop/phone notification when a turn that ran at least this long finishes, so you can work elsewhere meanwhile. 0 turns it off.
